text: Claude AI aur Claude Code ka har option samajhna hai?
Toh ye tutorial aapke liye hai!
Sabse pehle Claude AI ka home screen samajhiye.
Yahan se aap nayi chat shuru kar sakte hain,
purani conversations dekh sakte hain
aur available tools ke through apna kaam kar sakte hain.
Message box ke options se aap files attach kar sakte hain
aur supported tools use kar sakte hain.
Kaun sa option milega, ye aapke account
aur interface par depend karta hai.
Claude Code ek alag coding workflow hai.
Isse aap project files samajh sakte hain,
code likhwa sakte hain,
bugs debug kar sakte hain
aur development tasks mein help le sakte hain.
Lekin yaad rakhiye, AI ka code hamesha verify kijiye.
File access, commands aur advanced features
permissions aur setup par depend karte hain.
Agli videos mein har option step by step,
basic se advanced tak.
Channel subscribe kar lijiye!
